testcase.system-out: Scenario: Press Escape after opening the full ribbon expansion by pointer ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the Modify additional command area is unpinned ✔ When the user clicks the Modify panel title ✔ Then Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object are visible in the additional area ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the additional area remains visible with those commands ✔ When the user clicks the lower Modify title ✔ Then the additional area closes ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
